meta.description: Daily tracking state for F-1/SEVP/DS-2019 policy monitoring, focused on relevance to a Virginia Tech student who may need an extra semester to finish their degree.

items.title: DHS Final Rule: Fixed Time Period of Admission & Extension of Stay (ends Duration of Status) for F, J, I nonimmigrants
items.notes: Rule is published and not yet in effect (effective 2026-09-15). Subject to Congressional Review Act review; NAFSA and higher-ed associations have signaled intent to challenge but no lawsuit filed as of last check. Track for: CRA disapproval resolution, injunction/lawsuit filings, DHS FAQ updates, and any delay of the effective date.
